headline: Names a 9,765-foot mountain peak in Montana the Alex Diekmann Peak.
what_it_does: This law officially names an unnamed mountain peak in Montana as the Alex Diekmann Peak. The peak is 9,765 feet tall and sits about 2.2 miles west-northwest of Finger Mountain, on the western edge of the Lee Metcalf Wilderness. The law does not change land rules, access, or management of the area.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 31, 2018.
